build_Allegro_from_dataset: build an Allegro hand dataloader from a dataset path with base pose and joint states
build_Allegro_from_config: build an Allegro hand dataloader from a base pose config dictionary without a dataset
run_get_fk_by_index: run forward kinematics on the Allegro hand using a joint state index to get digit poses
run_get_fk_by_state: run forward kinematics on the Allegro hand using a raw joint state vector to get digit poses
run_load_robot: run load_robot to parse a URDF file and return the robot model, FK function, links, and joint map
